official.deadline_note: For the 2026 round all Portuguese Language and Culture programmes published a common window of 5 to 18 May 2026, closing at 5 p.m. Lisbon time. Provisional results followed with a 10-working-day preliminary hearing (dates of 9, 16, 17 and 19 June 2026 depending on the programme). Results in the definitive lists are published on Portal do Camoes, I.P. within 30 working days of the submission deadline.
official.application_cycle: 2026 round: applications open 5-18 May 2026 (17:00 Lisbon time) for the Fernao Mendes Pinto, Vieira, Pessoa, Research, Annual Course and Summer Course (in-person and online) programmes; provisional and definitive results published in June 2026
official.status_note: Every 2026 programme listed on the Camoes I.P. applications page has run its course: the application window closed 18 May 2026 and definitive results lists were published in June 2026. No 2027 window was published on the pages read.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Camoes I.P. pages describe the awards as supporting attendance at courses at Portuguese universities or institutions recognised by Camoes I.P., and as monthly payments, but make no statement about who pays tuition fees.
benefits: Support for improvement of language skills in Portuguese
Support for study and research in the area of Portuguese language and culture
Support for scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a Second Language
Support for training and improvement in translation and conference interpreting
Payment made monthly by bank transfer to the account of the scholarship holder, until the 10th day of each month, for the duration of the scholarship
Programmes offered in 2026: Annual Course, Summer Course (in-person and online), Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira
eligibility: Camoe I.P. states its scholarship programmes support individuals as part of Portuguese foreign cultural policy

The Portuguese Language and Culture scholarships support improvement of language skills, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a Second Language, and training or improvement in translation and conference interpreting
The Annual Course and Summer Course programmes support attendance at courses at Portuguese universities or at institutions recognised by Camoes I.P.
Applicants must be accepted by the host institution or course, which is why a work plan and acceptance documentation matter for the research-type programmes
requirements: Applications must be submitted electronically via the Camoes I.P. Services Portal (or the dedicated online form published for the online summer course)
Applications, the application form and the supporting documents required under the Camoes I.P. Scholarship Regulations must be submitted within the published window
Documents not written in Portuguese or English will not be considered during assessment; originals in other languages must be accompanied by a certified translation from a recognised authority
Documents requested after submission must be sent through the personal area using the 'New Message' tab
documents: Motivation letter explaining the reasons for applying and to what extent receiving the scholarship will contribute to the applicant's future professional career and the spreading of Portuguese language and culture (100 to 400 words)

Two recommendation letters from two people of recognised reputation, preferably from university professors working in the field of Portuguese, written in Portuguese or English, signed by the author, scanned and attached to the online application form

Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira applicants: a detailed work plan written in Portuguese with clear objectives and implementation deadlines (model available on Portal de Servicos when submitting)
Most recent household tax return properly identified (for means-tested awards such as the Andre Sousa Bessa equivalent, and where requested)
Scans must be submitted as PDF, JPEG or PNG; multiple documents for one purpose must be sent as a single compressed file in ZIP, RAR or multi-page PDF format
selection_criteria: Assessment of applications is made by a jury composed of three members, disclosed in the application opening notice
Provisional results are published with a 10-working-day window for candidates to comment and deliver missing documentation
Final results are entered in a list drawn up by the jury and published on Portal do Camoes, I.P. within 30 working days of the application deadline
coverage: Monthly payment by bank transfer until the 10th day of each month, for the duration of the scholarship
No statement on tuition, accommodation, travel or insurance coverage appears on the pages read
application_method: Read the Applications Notice PDF for the relevant programme and the Camoes I.P. Scholarship Regulations
Prepare the academic record, CV, motivation letter of 100-400 words and two recommendation letters, adding a work plan in Portuguese for Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira
Create an account on the Portal de Servicos do Camoes, I.P. and complete the application form
Upload the scans in the accepted formats and submit before 17:00 Lisbon time on the closing date
official.application_route: Submit electronically via the Portal de Servicos do Camoes, I.P. with the application form and all supporting documents; for the online summer course a dedicated online form is published in the applications notice.
official.international_eligibility: The scholarships are run as part of Portuguese foreign cultural policy in support of individuals abroad, and the applications are handled in Portuguese and English, indicating an outward-facing scheme; no explicit nationality restriction is published on the pages read.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Support is limited to Portuguese language and culture: language improvement, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, Portuguese as a Second Language, and translation and conference interpreting. Course-based programmes require attendance at a Portuguese university or an institution recognised by Camoes I.P.
official.research_requirement: Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira applicants must present a detailed work plan written in Portuguese with clear objectives and implementation deadlines.
official.description: Camoe I.P. offers scholarships to support individuals as part of Portuguese foreign cultural policy, with a set of Portuguese Language and Culture programmes supporting the improvement of language skills, study and research in Portuguese language and culture, scientific or professional training of Portuguese as a Second Language, and training or improvement in translation and conference interpreting.
official.program_type: National cultural institute scholarships in Portuguese language and culture (Camoe I.P.)
official.english_requirement: Documents not written in Portuguese or English are not considered during assessment; originals in other languages must be submitted with a certified translation from an authority recognised for the purpose. Recommendation letters must be written in Portuguese or English.

verification.notes: Read the Scholarships Camoes I.P. overview page, the scholarships-open-for-applications page with the 2026 notices and results lists, and the FAQ covering award conditions, documents required, assessment and payments. The 5-18 May 2026 window at 17:00 Lisbon time and the electronic submission via the Portal de Servicos are confirmed for every 2026 programme listed.

applicant_utility.summary: Camoe I.P. runs several parallel programmes on one shared calendar - in 2026 the Annual Course, Summer Course (in-person and online), Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira programmes all opened and closed on 5-18 May - so pick the programme that matches what you actually want to do, because the document requirements differ. Three programme families (Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa, Vieira) require a work plan written in Portuguese with clear objectives and implementation deadlines, which is the real time sink. Payment is monthly by bank transfer until the 10th of each month, so cash flow is predictable but the page never states the amount, the scholarship length, or whether tuition is covered.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Applicants who want to improve Portuguese, study or research Portuguese language and culture, train as a Portuguese-as-a-Second-Language professional, or train in translation and conference interpreting, and who can obtain Portuguese documentation.
application_readiness_checklist: Choose the correct programme: course attendance (Annual or Summer Course) versus the shorter-term or research-type programmes (Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa, Vieira)
Draft the work plan in Portuguese with clear objectives and implementation deadlines if you are applying to Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa or Vieira, using the model on Portal de Servicos

Write the motivation letter to the stated brief - reasons for applying and how the scholarship contributes to your professional career and the spread of Portuguese language and culture - and respect the 100 to 400 word range
Line up two recommendation letters from people of recognised reputation, preferably university professors of Portuguese, and make sure they are in Portuguese or English, signed and scanned
Create your Portal de Servicos do Camoe I.P. account well before the window opens, since applications are electronic only
Certify translations for anything not in Portuguese or English before the deadline, because uncertified documents are not considered
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 17:00 Lisbon time cut-off on the closing date
Submitting a motivation letter outside the 100-400 word range
Applying to Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa or Vieira without a work plan written in Portuguese
Uploading documents in a language other than Portuguese or English without a certified translation - those documents are simply not considered
Uploading scans in an unaccepted format, or splitting one set of certificates across several files instead of a single ZIP/RAR/multi-page PDF
Expecting to edit the application after submission - only address, telephone and email can be changed, everything else needs a message through the portal
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Nothing on the Camoe I.P. pages confirms tuition, accommodation, travel or insurance support, and no amount is published, so assume you cover tuition, travel to Portugal and full living costs on top of a monthly payment whose value you must confirm from the Scholarship Regulations or the applications notice.
document_audit: Statement of academic record, CV, Portuguese language training certificate (optional), motivation letter of 100-400 words and two recommendation letters are the base pack
Work plan in Portuguese with objectives and implementation deadlines for Fernao Mendes Pinto, Research, Pessoa and Vieira
If a requested document cannot be obtained in time, submit a statement explaining why - that substitute route is explicitly provided
Scans must be PDF, JPEG or PNG, and grouped documents must be one ZIP, RAR or multi-page PDF file

Recommendation letters have no fixed template, but should state how the author knows the applicant, what qualifies them to attest, and their expert view on the applicant's suitability for the work plan
alerts: Applications are electronic via the Portal de Servicos do Camoe I.P., and you cannot submit the same application twice
You may apply for another Portuguese scholarship programme, but if you are awarded a Camoe I.P. scholarship you cannot receive a similar scholarship from another Portuguese institution
Results lists are published on Portal do Camoe I.P. within 30 working days of the deadline, and the 2026 provisional lists carried a 10-working-day window to comment or supply missing documents
The Regulations PDF is linked as a scan, so verify amounts and conditions from it directly rather than from third-party summaries
The 2026 window has passed with definitive results published in June 2026, so the next round is likely to follow the same May pattern
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Pick the programme, build the base pack plus a Portuguese-language work plan where required, register on the Portal de Servicos, submit electronically inside the published May window, then watch for the provisional list and use the 10-working-day window to correct anything missing.
